item.title: U.S. Commerce Dept. Inquiry Into Megaspeed Was Halted After Nvidia Intervention
item.description: An investigation into Megaspeed, a Singapore company that was buying advanced Nvidia A.I. chips, was transferred to the Justice Department after a top Nvidia executive reached out to Commerce Department officials.

item.media:credit: Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times
item.media:description: Nvidia said on Sunday that it was opening an investigation into Jensen Huang, after he acknowledged he had been intimate with an executive at a Singaporean company suspected of smuggling chips into China.

item.title: An Anti-Trump Protest. Police Threats. Inside a Rift in Diabetes Research.

item.title: What Is Congress’s Plan to Speed Up Energy Permits?
item.description: The sprawling bill, which has divided Democrats, would overhaul major environmental laws to streamline the permitting process.
item.dc:creator: Brad Plumer

item.media:description: The legislation would overhaul several landmark environmental laws to make it easier for the federal government to approve all sorts of projects, from gas pipelines to subway expansions.

item.title: For Years, She Felt Awful. Her Flexible Joints Held a Clue.
